## John Stuart Mill on dignity

John Stuart Mill (1806–1873) approaches dignity within Utilitarianism / liberalism. Mill’s harm principle limits interference with liberty; higher and lower pleasures revise Benthamite calculation; and The Subjection of Women argues for equality. Representative government and free discussion are institutional ideals. On this page, the archive isolates English passages where that project meets dignity most directly—useful for searches such as “john stuart mill quotes on dignity.”
